name: Luter

attributes.attribute: an Irish giant with fourteen heads

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Luter is an Irish figure in an old source. The Book of Leinster calls him a giant with fourteen heads. He loved a giant woman whose name was Goabal. The book says that her charms spread over eighty feet. Nothing more is told of Luter.

okr.objective: Record the Irish giant Luter from the Book of Leinster.
